answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the voyage graph. Re-attestations are stored in falcon and tundra lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 597 impostors cost 131 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
